body.html: DEBUA White House is a small, newly opened boutique hotel in central Maha Sarakham, on Soi Srisawatdamnoen 6 in the Talat subdistrict, in the Somthawin Canal area of the city centre · Its main draw is its clean, white-minimalist styling that feels new and modern, unlike the older hotels in town that have been open for years · The building is small and the atmosphere is quiet — ideal for anyone who wants a good-looking, photogenic stay at a reasonable price.

Rooms are decorated mainly in white, going for a clean, understated look · Each has air conditioning, a refrigerator, microwave, kettle, safe, minibar and a big-screen TV with free Netflix, which many reviews single out as making a night in a small city far more comfortable · Some rooms have a balcony with a garden or city view · Real guest reviews say the beds are comfortable, the rooms look new and match the photos online · Worth knowing: some rooms are floored with a synthetic carpet that a few guests find hard to keep clean, and the bathroom design is a little quirky, though it works fine.
"Lovely room, clean white decor, feels brand new, big TV with Netflix, free parking, homemade breakfast cooked by the chef, very quiet — great value for Maha Sarakham."

One of the most talked-about things is the homemade breakfast cooked by the chef · Many reviews mention homemade garlic bread, Thai-style pan eggs (khai krata) and a made-to-order Thai breakfast served in a relaxed setting · A few say breakfast is on the light side and the coffee isn't to everyone's taste, but most praise it as heartfelt and tastier than you'd expect from a small hotel · There are also free bicycles to borrow for a ride around town, a garden to sit in, a small bar, a minimarket and EV charging — rare for a property this size.

Location is another plus · DEBUA White House sits in the Talat area of the city centre, about 2 km from the heart of Maha Sarakham, near Somthawin Canal, a local walking and exercise spot · There are restaurants, coffee shops and small bars to walk to nearby · It's an easy trip to Maha Sarakham University and Rajabhat Maha Sarakham University, making it handy for parents dropping off students or anyone with business in town · There's free on-site parking, ideal for self-drivers.

Honestly, from real reviews: DEBUA White House is a good-looking, good-value hotel, but still a new property where service and upkeep aren't fully settled · Some reviews mention a receptionist who isn't yet up to speed, water leaking from upper floors in a few rooms, and some mould in bathrooms — while many other reviews praise friendly, helpful staff · Consistency is something to allow for with a small new hotel · Also note that there aren't many restaurants within walking distance; for a varied dinner you may need to drive into the main market area.

In short, if you want a place in Maha Sarakham that looks new, clean and photogenic, with free parking and a freshly made breakfast, in the high-hundreds-to-low-thousands range, DEBUA White House is a sensible pick · A score of around 8.1 from guests captures it well: pretty rooms, good value, central location and a quiet feel — just allow for the service inconsistency of a newly opened hotel · It suits couples, small families, parents visiting students, and anyone breaking up an Isan road trip.

A tip from following the reviews here: there are two DEBUA branches in Maha Sarakham — make sure you book the White House one on Soi Srisawatdamnoen 6 in the Talat area, not the other branch in a different part of town · And because it's a small new hotel, message the Facebook page directly to check opening promos and room condition before booking — some days the rate including breakfast drops into the high-hundreds.

honestSummary: DEBUA White House is a solid choice for anyone who wants a new-looking, white-themed place in Maha Sarakham with free parking and a freshly made breakfast, in the high-hundreds-to-low-thousands range — clean, central and quiet · But you have to accept that it's a small, newly opened hotel where service and upkeep aren't fully settled; it suits guests who value pretty, good-value rooms over big-hotel service.
honestChecks: If you expect the steady service and consistent upkeep of a large hotel — this place is brand new and some service points are still being ironed out → message the page directly to check room condition and ask for the most ready room before booking.
If you want a variety of dinner spots within walking distance — there aren't many restaurants right around the hotel → driving into the main market area or ordering delivery is easier.
If you're booking online — there are two DEBUA branches in Maha Sarakham → make sure it's the White House branch on Soi Srisawatdamnoen 6 in the Talat area, not the other one.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — DEBUA White House Maha Sarakham

faq.q: Where is DEBUA White House in Maha Sarakham, and what's nearby?
faq.a: DEBUA White House is at 31 Soi Srisawatdamnoen 6, Talat subdistrict, in the Somthawin Canal area of central Maha Sarakham · It's about 2 km from the heart of town and the Talat market area · Somthawin Canal is about a 5-minute walk · Rajabhat Maha Sarakham University and Wat Maha Chai are about a 5-minute drive, and Maha Sarakham University about 15 minutes by car.

faq.q: How much does DEBUA White House cost, and what rooms are available?
faq.a: Rates start at approx. ฿850/night for a Standard room with a king bed · Twin rooms and Deluxe rooms with a balcony run around ฿900-฿1,100, with family rooms higher · During opening promos, some days the rate including breakfast drops into the high-hundreds · Prices vary by date, so compare Agoda, Booking and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: Does DEBUA White House have breakfast and parking?
faq.a: Yes to both · The hotel serves a homemade buffet breakfast cooked by the chef, roughly 6.30-10.00, and has free on-site parking with EV charging · The breakfast highlights are homemade garlic bread and made-to-order pan eggs · There are also free bicycles to borrow, a garden, a small bar and an on-site minimarket.

faq.q: Who is DEBUA White House best for?
faq.a: It's best for couples, small families, parents visiting students, and anyone who wants pretty, photogenic rooms at an affordable price · It suits self-drivers thanks to the free parking · It's less suited to anyone wanting the steady service of a large hotel or a variety of restaurants within walking distance.

faq.q: Are the rooms at DEBUA White House clean, and what should I know?
faq.a: Most reviews say the rooms look new, with clean white decor that matches the online photos · Worth knowing: it's a small, newly opened hotel, so upkeep is sometimes inconsistent — some rooms have a synthetic carpet that's hard to keep clean, and a few reviews note water leaks or bathroom mould · Message the page to check room condition and ask for the most ready room before booking.

faq.q: What's the difference between DEBUA White House and the other Debua branch in Maha Sarakham?
faq.a: There are two DEBUA branches in Maha Sarakham · The White House branch reviewed here is on Soi Srisawatdamnoen 6 in the Talat area, near Somthawin Canal in the city centre · The other branch is in a different part of town · Before booking online, check that the name and address match the White House branch so you don't book the wrong one.
